Hi Soojin,

Quick follow from our compliance team: as part of Clearshore's annual SOC 2 recert, they flagged two supplemental artifact requests for 2025 Q4. The asks are: a) a short addendum with explicit retention evidence for audit logs (365->540 days for the attestation snapshot), and b) an extract of the security event logs for the period Jul–Sep 2025 (we need a hashed bundle + manifest).

We also want to discuss a temporary seat/burst arrangement so our auditors can run parallel sampling without throttling. Can you confirm:
- Whether Redwood can provide a short-term retention extension for the audit window (explicit manifest + signed stamp),
- Approx timeline for producing the Jul–Sep log slice and a secure transfer mechanism (SFTP or presigned S3),
- Pricing for a 30-day seat surge (approx. 10 concurrent audit workers).

I attached our evidence_matrix_v2.xlsx to map items to the audit checklist. We can do a quick sync tomorrow if that's easiest.

Thanks,
Maria (on behalf of Clearshore security)

High level plan from our side:
- Retention addendum: we can produce a signed policy addendum confirming a 540-day retention carveout for the JUL–SEP 2025 audit snapshot. Target: legal/priv sec sign-off within 48 business hours once we agree wording.
- Log slice transfer: we'll prepare a hashed bundle (SHA256 manifest) and offer an SFTP endpoint or presigned, encrypted S3 upload. Preference: presigned S3 (automated lifecycle expired link). Expected prep time: 3 business days after confirmation of the exact object list.
- Temporary seats / seat surge: we can provision a 30‑day burst pool; pricing estimate is a one‑time usage uplift + pro rata seat fee. Vanessa will share numbers in a follow-up.

Proposed staging window: 2025-11-24 -> 2025-12-04 (10 business days) for staging/validation, with production snapshot handoff on 2025-12-05 if all checks pass. If Clearshore needs earlier access we can compress to 6 business days but that will compress verification time.

I'll attach a short staging-plan PDF with timelines and the minimal evidence list. Next steps: confirm the staging window and preferred transfer method, and we'll kick off the internal approvals immediately.

Regards,
